{{recipesummary|category=Breakfast recipes|servings=6|time=20 minutes
or 40 minutes if you have to peel the shrimp|difficulty=2}} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast Recipes|Breakfast Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Seafood|Seafood]] ==Ingredients== * 3–4 strips thickened smoked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] large [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]] * 6 servings of [[Cookbook:Grits|grits]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|sharp cheddar cheese]] * ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] * ½ large sweet [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], cut into thin strips * ½ yellow [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], cut into strips * ½ red bell pepper, cut into strips * 2–3 [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] * ¼–½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] hot sauce, or to taste (optional) * [[Cookbook:Lime|juice of one lime]] ==Procedure== # [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] bacon until crisp, remove and set aside. # [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] onions, garlic, and peppers in bacon grease, add lime juice and hot sauce and set aside. # Prepare grits per the directions on box. Add cheese and butter when done cooking to allow for them to melt, then set aside. # Stir when done melting. # Sauté the shrimp until they turn pink, about 2–3 minutes. # Place the grits and cheese in large serving container and place the shrimp down the center of the container. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * If served on individual dish/platter, serve sliced [[Cookbook:Lime|limes]] on the side. * In preparing the grits, you may want to use [[Cookbook:Milk|condensed milk]] instead of [[Cookbook:Water|water]] to make the grits for an extra creamy texture! * As an alternative, add garden [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]] to grits and serve with steamed [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]], yellow [[Cookbook:Squash|squash]], and [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]] on the side. Adds a great taste texture with the peas! * If you are planning to use unpeeled shrimp, plan an extra 20 minutes to peel the shrimp! [[Category:Southern U.S. recipes]] [[Category:Camping recipes]] [[Category:Breakfast recipes]] [[Category:Fried recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using bacon]] [[Category:Recipes using cheddar]] [[Category:Recipes using onion]] [[Category:Recipes using shrimp]] [[Category:Naturally gluten-free recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using red bell pepper]] [[Category:Recipes using yellow bell pepper]] [[Category:Recipes using lime juice]] [[Category:Recipes using hot sauce]]
